narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this section, we're going to dive deeper into solving systems of linear equations using the algebraic method, specifically focusing on the elimination method. We'll also tackle some real-world word problems and learn how to translate them into solvable equations. Our goal is to master the elimination method for solving linear equations. We will also learn to solve complex word problems by setting up and solving equations using elimination. Finally, we will analyze real-world scenarios and translate them into mathematical models.
